listsPrompt: Select the ClickUp lists to use:
wipStatusPrompt: Select the in-progress status for list {list}:
noWipStatus: List {list} has no status for work in progress, so wip stays unset. task.move to wip fails for its tasks until you add one and re-run init.
membersPrompt: Cache workspace members in the config? (optional; assignment works without it)
targetPromptTime: ClickUp supports native time estimates. Write target:
targetTime: time — native time estimate (recommended for ideal_hours / ideal_days)
targetNone: none — store as est: tag only
autonomousPrompt: Enable autonomous mode? (agent can write to ClickUp without per-action confirmation)
noCredentials: pm-tasks-clickup init needs access to ClickUp. Set CLICKUP_API_TOKEN to a personal API token (ClickUp → Settings → Apps → API Token) and run init again, or run init inside an agent session that has the ClickUp MCP connected.
noWorkspaceFound: These credentials see no ClickUp workspace. Check the token, then run init again.
noListsFound: Workspace {workspace} has no lists. Create a list in ClickUp, then run init again.
listSkippedNoOpen: List {list} was skipped: it has no status of type open. Add one in ClickUp and run init again to use it.
listSkippedNoDone: List {list} was skipped: it has no status of type done or closed. Add one in ClickUp and run init again to use it.
noUsableList: None of the chosen lists can be pinned: each needs an open status and a done or closed status. Nothing was written.
nextAutonomous: Autonomous mode was written with enabled: false. Set autonomous.enabled to true in the config when you want the agent to write without asking.
initErrorAuth: The ClickUp API token was rejected (malformed, invalid or without access). Set CLICKUP_API_TOKEN to a valid personal API token (ClickUp → Settings → Apps → API Token), then run init again.
initErrorRateLimit: The ClickUp rate limit was reached. Wait a minute, then run init again.
initErrorHttp: ClickUp answered with HTTP {status}. Try again later.
initErrorNetwork: Could not reach ClickUp (network error or timeout). Check the connection, then run init again.
initErrorResponse: ClickUp sent a response init could not read. Run init again; if it keeps failing, report it.
initErrorWorkspace: The workspace is not among those these credentials can access.
errorListNotConfigured: List {listId} is not in .clickup.json. Run pm-tasks-clickup init to register it.
errorRoleNotConfigured: List {list} has no status pinned for the {role} role. Re-run pm-tasks-clickup init to pin one.
errorDetachUnsupported: Detaching a subtask from its parent is not supported by the ClickUp MCP.
doctorNoLists: No lists found in config. Re-run init.
doctorNoDone: List {list} has no done status pinned. Re-run init.
doctorStatusDrift: List {list}: the pinned status "{status}" ({role}) no longer exists in ClickUp. Re-run init to pin the current statuses.
doctorNoProbe: Live ClickUp checks (C-CLK-7, C-CLK-8) skipped: set CLICKUP_API_TOKEN to run them.
doctorEstimationMismatch: estimation.clickupTarget is 'time' but the strategy is not time-based (ideal_hours or ideal_days). Re-run init.
doctorAutonomousDisabled: autonomous.enabled is not true — autonomous mode is off.
doctorConfigInvalid: The config at {path} is empty, is not valid JSON or has no version field. Fix it or re-run init.
doctorNoWorkspace: workspace.id is missing in .clickup.json. Re-run init.
doctorNoOpen: List {list} has no open status pinned. Re-run init.
doctorHoursPerDay: estimation.hoursPerDay must be a number from 1 to 24.
doctorEstimationOff: Estimation is disabled: task.estimate.set answers NOT_APPLICABLE.
doctorScopeUnknownList: autonomous.scope.lists names list {list}, which is not in lists[].
doctorAliasUnresolved: defaults.{field} "{alias}" matches no member alias and is not "me".
doctorWorkspaceHidden: Workspace {workspace} is not among the workspaces this credential can access.
doctorLiveSkipped: Status drift check skipped because C-CLK-7 failed (see its message).
doctorListUnreadable: List {list} could not be read from ClickUp: {reason}
doctorListInaccessible: List {list}: ClickUp refused to read it (HTTP {status}) although the workspace is reachable; the list was deleted, moved, or this account lost access. Remove it from lists[] or re-run init.
doctorListsNotChecked: {count} more list(s) were not checked after that error.
